verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a granular OAuth 2.0 scope system (resource:permission pattern, e.g. transactions:read, cards:read_vault, bills:write) with least-privilege guidance, and this is concretely instantiated for agents via a live-verified MCP server that requires OAuth and enumerates dozens of fine-grained read/write scopes (including agentic-specific ones like cards:read_agentic, agent_wallet_policy). Standalone agent credentials via OAuth client-credentials, per-agent identity/attribution, spend-scoped Funds, and expiring sessions further reinforce least-privilege agent credentialing. Missing for 10: independent third-party security audit or hands-on confirmation of scope enforcement beyond Ramp's own docs/probes.
